rows.rule: Classify each instance by its children (hidden components and tagcrumb ignored, sectionseparator = divider), first match wins. A) all columns empty -> skip. B) only one column has content -> no Columns: emit that column's content as default content / its block in the section (XF only -> Fragment block, form only -> Marketo Form block). C) a Marketo form with content beside it -> one section with style 'flex' (equal halves = the source 50/50) holding, in order, default content, Marketo Form block, Fragment block. D) a column holds a block-level component (accordion, table, tabs, mixedmediagallery, animatedbarchart, interactivemedia, engagementcta, nested column control) -> blocks cannot nest in Columns cells: emit column 1 then column 2 in a 'flex' section; if every column is a numbercounter -> one Statistics block, one item per column. E) an XF next to inline content -> 'flex' section: default content + Fragment block. F) both columns = image FIRST + title (heading, Large Headline or fully bold line) + CTA (curatedcta/buttonset or a link alone in the last paragraph), no video -> Cards Corp (two-up), one row per column; consecutive card rows merge into one block. G) otherwise -> Columns (columns-50-50), one row per instance, one cell per column, children in authored order. G modifiers (existing corp variants): large-headline when a cell has a Large Headline; related-links when a cell is a list of standalone links; gold-first / gray-lead / boxed-last when the text box of the first/last cell is gold / light gray / dimensional box; media-pair when the cells are only stacked images. Videos stay in the cell (DM .m3u8?poster= or YouTube link; columns.js renders both).
rows.contentModel: Columns (columns-50-50[, large-headline|related-links|media-pair|gold-first|gray-lead|boxed-last]): 1 row x 2 cells; each cell = the column's children in order (DM image link, headings/paragraphs per typography table, CTA = link alone in its paragraph with convention formatting, video link). Cards Corp (two-up): one row per column: cell 1 image (DM link), cell 2 title + text + CTA.

proposedNames.name: large-headline
proposedNames.why: Standalone Large Headlines (outside columns/heroes; about 40% at 3vw or larger) use the fluid vw scale (fontsize-<n>vw = 2n vw on phones, n vw from 840px, capped at n x 14px from 1439px, so 28-70px). This section style would apply the type scale that the existing Columns (large-headline) variant already defines (h1 = headline, Bold h1 = stat number, Bold+Italic = gold) to default content. One name instead of one style per size. It covers the static large numbers (e.g. teal '93%' over serif text), as briefed: static large text = plain text plus a size section style.
